fusions.name: Unhurried Weight
fusions.desc: A slow, full-weight kick at a target up to 3 tiles away that deals 30 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full range. Bosses and elites also lose 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Wallowing Wake
fusions.desc: You wallow forward, dealing 3 damage to everything in a cone up to 3 tiles ahead, with a 30% chance per hit to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Easy Pace
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 20 seconds.

fusions.name: Nothing Urgent
fusions.desc: The moment your health is full, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
